headline: Moderna Stock Tumbles Following Reported Leak of Cancer Vaccine Data
summary: Moderna's stock tumbled following a reported data leak for its experimental cancer vaccine. Moderna and Merck are expected to share Phase 3 data for the vaccine this weekend at a medical conference.
why: Moderna is a biotechnology company focused on messenger RNA (mRNA) therapeutics and vaccines, making its pipeline developments critical for its valuation.

impacts.name: Moderna
impacts.why: A data leak concerning a key late-stage clinical candidate spooks investors and weighs on the company's valuation.

why_moved: The reported leak of clinical trial data for an experimental cancer vaccine raised investor concerns, triggering a sell-off in Moderna shares ahead of official data releases.
